checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: The clip is 8 s and the frames are vertical, about 474x864.

must.item: Numerals 3, 2, 1 in order, then the reveal
must.why: The 3 shows at 0.8 s. The 3.2 s frame already shows the NEON NIGHT reveal. No 2 or 1 appears in any sampled frame, so they may have flashed briefly between samples or may be missing.

must.item: Electronic music builds with accents on numeral changes
must.why: The audio has sound with a peak of -4.8 dB. Its content and sync cannot be judged.

must.item: Neon lighting visibly changes during the countdown
must.why: The 3 is pink neon with cyan light flares. By 3.2 s the scene has changed to the cyan and pink neon sign with smoke.

must.item: Final card shows all three lines together for at least 3 s, no clipped text
must.why: The full card is readable at 5.6 s and 7.6 s, and the reveal starts before 4 s. The date line sits very close to the bottom of NIGHT. The 5.6 s frame looks dimmer.
The audio was not transcribed, so speech cannot be judged.

exact_text.read_as: not visible in any sampled frame
not visible in any sampled frame

faults.what: The 2 and 1 are not visible in any sampled frame. The countdown looks like 3 straight to the reveal, so the requested 3-2-1 may be missing.
The date line is crammed against the bottom of the NIGHT neon letters, almost touching them. The plain white sans text also looks pasted on rather than neon-styled.
The end card text looks dimmer and greyer at 5.6 s, so it flickers or fades in. The 3.2 s reveal frame also shows the neon sign cropped at the left and right edges.

summary: The clip has a strong neon 3, then a neon NEON NIGHT reveal and a held end card with correct text, but the 2 and 1 are not visible in any sampled frame and the date line is cramped against the logo.
